journal.starfallen.page.0:
§5§lThe Starseer's Journal§r

§8Being a true account of the stars that fell, and of the thing that fell with them.


§o- Brother Aldric,
last of the Astral Order
journal.starfallen.page.1:
§l§6Starfall§r

On some nights the sky breaks open. Meteors rain down, carving glowing craters and scattering §8Meteoric Iron§r, §eStardust§r and §bStarlit Crystals§r.

A §6Starfall Beacon§r can call one down at will.
journal.starfallen.page.2:
§l§6Craters§r

Mine the §8Meteoric Iron Ore§r around a crater's heart. Large meteors leave a §6Fallen Star§r at their core: break it for §eStar Fragments§r.

Beware - Meteor Golems sometimes ride the meteors down.
journal.starfallen.page.3:
§l§6Golden Meteors§r
Once in a while a meteor burns gold. Its crater is lined with gold, diamonds and emeralds.

§l§bStellar Eggs§r
Some large meteors carry an egg. Feed it §eStardust§r and it hatches into a §bComet Ray§r that is yours to ride.
journal.starfallen.page.4:
§l§6Forging§r

§8Meteoric Iron§r
Smelt Raw Meteoric Iron.

§bAstral Alloy§r
2 Meteoric Iron, 4 Stardust and 1 Star Fragment.

§5Voidsteel§r
2 Astral Alloy and 4 Void Essence.
journal.starfallen.page.5:
§l§6Star Armor§r

§8Meteoric§r - land from a height to unleash a shockwave; magma cannot burn you.

§bStarforged§r - double jump in mid-air.

§5Voidwalker§r - press §lV§r to blink to wherever you look.
journal.starfallen.page.6:
§l§6Star Wisps§r

Little lights that drift down on clear nights. Offer one §eStardust§r and it may choose you: it fights at your side and mends your wounds.

§l§dNebula Jellies§r
Harmless... until struck.
journal.starfallen.page.7:
§l§bComet Rays§r

Great gliding rays that swim through the sky during a Starfall. Win one over with Stardust or a Star Fragment, then saddle up and ride the stars.

§oJump§r to climb, §osprint§r to boost.
journal.starfallen.page.8:
§l§6Meteor Golems§r

Molten giants born in the impact. They pound the earth and hurl burning rock.

When the fire in their core runs low they §cOVERHEAT§r - that is your moment to strike.
journal.starfallen.page.9:
§4§lVoid Stalkers§r

They cannot move while you look at them.

Do not look away.

Do not blink.

If you hear it breathing behind you, it is already too late.
journal.starfallen.page.10:
§l§eStarseers§r

Cultists who worship the fallen star. They hurl star bolts and pull meteors down from the sky.

Their master, the §6High Starseer§r, keeps watch at the top of the §bAstral Observatory§r.
journal.starfallen.page.11:
§l§bThe Observatory§r

A tower of pale bricks under open skies. Look through its great §6telescope§r and the stars will show you the way to the Sanctum.

The Observatory keeps more than one secret.

§oMind the chests.
journal.starfallen.page.12:
§l§5The Sanctum§r

Beneath a lonely obelisk lie halls of void brick: traps, watchers in the dark, and the §bSeal§r.

Light all four §bAstral Braziers§r with Stardust, flint and steel or a fire charge to break it.
journal.starfallen.page.13:
§l§5The Sigil§r

The Order hid the §dSigil of the Fallen Star§r in a vault. Our librarians were very fond of secret doors.

Place the Sigil upon the §5Star Altar§r...

§oonly if you are ready.
journal.starfallen.page.14:
§4§lAstraeon§r

The Devouring Star. It rains meteors, fires a beam that unmakes stone, slams the earth and births black holes.

Wounded, it breaks its chains - and at the very end it goes §6supernova§r.
§lTake cover.
journal.starfallen.page.15:
§l§6Star Weapons§r

§6Cratermaker§r: leap & slam
§bNebula Blade§r: star dash
§bConstellation Bow§r: homing stars
§5Riftblade§r: strike from behind
§5Singularity Gauntlet§r: black holes
§6Starcaller Staff§r: call meteors
journal.starfallen.page.16:
§l§6The Heart§r

From Astraeon's heart one may forge the §eHalo of the Fallen Star§r, the §5Eclipse Scythe§r, and the §6Totem of the Fallen Star§r - which turns your death into a supernova.
journal.starfallen.page.17:
§8§oIf you are reading this, the stars are falling again.

Look up.

Something is looking back.
book.starfallen.observatory.title: Observations, Vol. IX
book.starfallen.observatory.1:
Night 212.

The comet grows brighter every night. The High Starseer calls it a blessing.

I am not so sure.
book.starfallen.observatory.2:
Night 219.

The great telescope has shown me where the old Sanctum lies. Anyone who looks through its lens will see it too.
book.starfallen.observatory.3:
Night 220.

I have hidden my last notes where no one ever looks: beneath the red carpet.

The Starseers must not find them.
book.starfallen.sanctum.title: On the Sanctum
book.starfallen.sanctum.1: The Order built the Sanctum to hold what fell. Four braziers bind the Seal. While even one burns cold, the Seal holds.
book.starfallen.sanctum.2: The vault keeps the Sigil, the only key to the altar. The way to it is hidden among the books.
book.starfallen.sanctum.3:
Should the altar ever wake, do not stand still. Its beam follows the eye.

Keep moving.
book.starfallen.secret.title: My Last Entry
book.starfallen.secret.1:
They know. The High Starseer means to wake Astraeon with the Sigil.

I have carried what treasure I could down here.
book.starfallen.secret.2:
If you find this: take the egg. Raise the ray. They were the stars' children long before we came.

- Aldric
book.starfallen.sanctum_lore.title: The Fall
book.starfallen.sanctum_lore.1: In the age before the Order, a star fell and did not die. It ate the light of everything around it.
book.starfallen.sanctum_lore.2: Nine hundred of us gave our starlight to bind it. We named it Astraeon, and buried it beneath the Hall of Stars.
book.starfallen.sanctum_lore.3:
The Seal will hold for as long as the braziers stay cold.

Let no one light them.
book.starfallen.hint.title: A Librarian's Riddle
book.starfallen.hint.1:
Where knowledge is thickest, the wall is thinnest.

Seek the shelf that is carved unlike all the rest.
book.starfallen.hint.2:
Behind it lies what we could not destroy.

- Archivist Venn
